items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 45:1
items.html: (To the question) Because the kings of HGT are aspects of GAR of ZAT, they are therefore attributed to the GAR of BYA. (p. 539, entry "and with this")
